posts.text: 🇺🇦 Ukrainian military demands removal of mobilisation deferments for students over 25 Representatives of the Ukrainian military command are preparing an appeal to cancel mobilisation deferments for students aged over 25, according to Verkhovna Rada deputy Ruslan Gorbenko from the "Servant of the People" faction. Gorbenko stated that political consent from Vladimir Zelensky is required to adopt such a decision. Meanwhile, Ukraine's Deputy Minister of Education Trofimenko defended the right of adult citizens to education, emphasising that studying after age 25 is not a violation. The Ministry of Education also reported regular checks on older students. Thus, the issue of cancelling deferments remains a point of disagreement between military leadership and the education department. @Slavyangrad

The breast-shaped porcelain bowl was one of four such pieces which King Louis XVI once ordered for his queen's royal dairy creamery. 👉 Read more: https://f24.my/CJFL.g

فرنسا تستقبل 38 فلسطينيا في عملية إجلاء جديدة من قطاع غزة وصل 38 فلسطينيا أُجلوا من قطاع غزة إلى فرنسا بين الأربعاء والخميس في إطار عملية جديدة نسقتها باريس، بحسب ما أفادت وزارة الخارجية الفرنسية. وترفع هذه العملية، وهي الرابعة منذ مطلع العام، إلى 773 العدد الإجمالي للأشخاص الذين أُجلوا من غزة بدعم من باريس منذ تشرين الثاني/نوفمبر 2023، وقد استقبلت فرنسا 753 منهم. 👈 اقرأ المزيد: https://f24.my/CJFK.g

An athlete from Ukraine’s Rivne region has won three medals at the European Para Dance Sport Championships. Competing in Class 2, Ivan Sivak claimed silver and bronze in the men’s solo freestyle category. He also took silver in the Combi category, in which one partner uses a wheelchair, performing alongside his dance partner, Olena Dankevych. The Ukrainian national para dance sport team won nine medals in total, finishing second in the overall medal standings. 📸 : Rivne Regional State Administration/Facebook
